items.heading: Sap Is the System Many
items.text: SAP is the system many large Indian companies use for finance, buying, sales, plants and HR. People who can configure it, extend it or explain it are paid for keeping those companies running.

items.heading: "Sap Career" Is Not One
items.text: "SAP career" is not one job. The order below is a judgement about how far income and independence can stretch with skill and proof. Development skills that also work outside SAP lead.

items.heading: Most of the Hiring Noise
items.text: Most of the hiring noise comes from one date. Companies running the older SAP ERP 6.0 (ECC) must decide how to move to S/4HANA or pay extra to stay.

rows: BTP, integration and ABAP Cloud development
Builds apps and connections around the SAP core using ABAP Cloud, APIs and SAP Business Technology Platform. Job listings from DXC, Deloitte and Capgemini pair ABAP with BTP or RAP skills.
Engineering, BCA, MCA or self-taught coders
Scalable The skills (APIs, cloud, one general language) also work outside SAP, and extensions can be sold as projects.
Functional consultant: FICO, MM, SD, PP
Sits between the business and the system. Runs workshops, configures the module, tests, trains staff and fixes problems after go-live.
B.Com, CA, MBA, supply chain or plant experience
Scalable with a business layer The biggest hiring pool. Pay grows with full project cycles; boutique or independent consulting is the business layer.
Cloud HR and procurement suites: SuccessFactors, Ariba
Same consulting work, inside SAP cloud products for HR or buying. Smaller pool, more product-specific.
Scalable with a business layer Domain depth is the edge; a narrow niche can be sold as specialist consulting.
Analytics and planning: SAP Analytics Cloud, BW, Datasphere
Moves SAP data into reports and plans. Needs SQL and data-model thinking as much as SAP screens.
Scalable with a business layer Pairs SAP data with general analytics skills that also sell outside SAP.

items.heading: Use Free Content to See
items.text: Use free content to see the work. Take one free SAP Learning journey in the track you are considering. Check how you feel after a few sessions, not after one.

items.heading: Run One Real Process
items.text: Run one real process in a practice system. If you are enrolled in a university, use the free student edition. If not, use the free trial. Run one process from start to finish and write what each step does in plain words.

items.heading: Explain IT to Someone Who
items.text: Explain it to someone who works in the business. Two minutes to a finance, plant or HR person. Ask them what they would want fixed. Their answers are your first proof of communication.

items.heading: Talk to Two People Working
items.text: Talk to two people working in your track. Ask about shift pattern, travel, remote or hybrid rules, and what they would learn first if they started again. Write both answers down.
